race.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Best Odds Guaranteed Overnight' Handicap
race.verdict: ANVIKA failed to finish through no fault of her own at the Curragh last month, having clipped heels and unseated her rider, so she's well worth another chance to supplement her recent Curragh success given she remains well treated on old form. Serenity Blue ought to go well again, while his stablemate Star Harbour is also of interest returning to all-weather. ANVIKA (IRE) SERENITY BLUE STAR HARBOUR (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: El Galvino (9/2), Serenity Blue (5/1), Xirivella (5/1), Anvika (13/2), Sonoran (7/1), Spicy Margarita (8/1), Star Harbour (8/1), Diamond Exchange (12/1), Letiza (12/1), Unterberg (14/1), Brewing (20/1)
